description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kiribathkumbura, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320552
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership determinations, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
